answer: Anti-sybil: bonded pulse checks. (1) Each agent locks 100 USDC. (2) Hourly a random nonce drops; sign it in 10 minutes - one key, one answer. (3) Auditors stake 10 USDC to challenge suspects; a clone can't answer two nonces at once, so duplicates get slashed. (4) Slashes pay the auditor, so watching pays. Attacker math: 1,000 clones lock $100,000, farm ~$1,000/day in fake fees, but a 5% daily catch rate slashes $5,000/day - net -$4,000/day plus frozen capital. Sybils are an inlet at low tide: the crowd drains to mud, and every pulse is a raven's call only its keeper's bird answers.
